notes:
Summary: Saguaro Chatworks is a mid-market e-commerce platform (marketplace + merchant support). Heavy live-chat volume for returns and order issues. Primary interest: reduce live-agent load via deflection and strong agent-assist when handoff happens. Cost pressure: internal finance wants predictable unit economics for chat (target ~ $0.0015 - $0.003 per message across average session). They run heavy diurnal spikes (Black Friday-level spikes are a planning constraint) and need graceful degradation + fallbacks.

Technical requirements / constraints: 
- Workloads: ~60k incoming messages/day baseline, peak spikes up to 12k msgs/min during promos, sustaining 2k concurrent interactive sessions.
- Latency: p95 generation latency target <= 600ms for single-turn answers; agent-assist calls can tolerate up to 1s but prefer <800ms.
- Throughput: target steady-state throughput 800-1,200 msg/min, burst to 12k/min for short windows.
- Cost sensitivity: want options to trade quality for unit cost: quantized model variants, aggressive batching, prefix/KV caching for repeated queries.
- Model preference: open-models acceptable; tested small Llama-family and quantized Vicuna variants. Interested in Redwood's catalog + recommended quantization bundles.
- Reliability: must have automatic fallbacks (smaller model variant or cached response) and regional routing for NA + EU traffic.
- Security: SSO (SAML), company-managed KMS, audit logs retained 1 year, data residency options for EU customers.
- Integrations: Zendesk + internal tooling for tool-calling (order lookup, refund action). Want structured tool outputs to auto-fill tickets.

Quotes / call notes: 
- "We need the math: how do batching and KV caching move the price per message?" — Head of Ops
- "If we can't guarantee cost under promotions we can't proceed to buy" — Finance lead
- "Prefer a two-arm POC: a quality-first baseline and a cost-first baseline to compare metrics" — Product Owner

POC plan (agreed):
- 4-week POC: ingest scrubbed chat history (subset), run live shadow traffic for 2 weeks, then divert 10% live for last 2 weeks.
- Two config arms: (A) aggressive batching + cached prefixes + 4-bit quantized model (cost-first), (B) moderate batching + 8-bit quantized + no aggressive cache (quality-first).
- Key metrics: p95 latency, deflection rate (resolved w/out agent), tokens per resolved session, cost per resolution, fallbacks triggered, user satisfaction (CSAT sample).

Open risks / blockers: 
- Infosec wants full encryption-at-rest proof for POC dataset (waiting on cloud KMS integration doc).
- Finance needs deterministic 12-month cost projection for procurement.
- Merchant data contains EU customers — need data residency and DPA addendum.

Next tactical steps: 
- SE to share recommended batching/caching knobs and estimation script (Priya).
- Sales to provide templated cost model with scenario analysis for finance.
- Customer to provide scrubbed sample dataset and sample Zendesk webhook config.

Internal notes for AE/SE:
- Emphasize Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantization profiles) to hit sub-$0.002/msg.
- Prepare fallback plan and canary rollback procedure for POC.
- Track spike simulation plan (generate synthetic promo traffic)
